svg.title: CA creation workflow diagram
svg.desc: Full workflow showing CA creation from entropy sources through key generation, certificate template assembly, signing, storage, and usage patterns, with error and danger annotations.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does crypto/rand.Reader work on Linux and why is it safe?')
sendPrompt('How do you use an HSM or KMS as the key source for a CA in Go?')
sendPrompt('When would you load an existing private key for a CA instead of generating one?')
sendPrompt('What causes entropy starvation in containers and CVMs, and how do you mitigate it?')
sendPrompt('Compare RSA 4096 vs ECDSA P-256 vs Ed25519 for CA key generation in Go')
sendPrompt('Show me Go code to generate an ECDSA P-256 private key for a CA')
sendPrompt('What key sizes and algorithms are considered weak or broken for CA keys?')
sendPrompt('How do you extract a public key from a private key in Go for use in a certificate?')
sendPrompt('How should I generate a serial number for a CA certificate in Go?')
sendPrompt('What Subject fields should I set on a CA certificate?')
sendPrompt('What validity period should I use for root and intermediate CA certificates, and how should I handle clock skew?')
sendPrompt('What are the risks of serial number collision and clock skew in X.509 certificates?')
sendPrompt('What KeyUsage bits should I set on a CA certificate in Go?')
sendPrompt('Why is BasicConstraints IsCA:true critical in a CA certificate?')
sendPrompt('How do I set SubjectKeyId and AuthorityKeyIdentifier on a CA certificate in Go?')
sendPrompt('Should I set ExtKeyUsage on a CA certificate, and should I include CRL or OCSP URLs?')
sendPrompt('What happens if BasicConstraints is missing or IsCA is false on a CA certificate?')
sendPrompt('What are the consequences of not implementing CRL or OCSP for a CA?')
sendPrompt('Show me a complete Go struct for an x509.Certificate CA template')
sendPrompt('What is the difference between creating a self-signed root CA and an intermediate CA in Go?')
sendPrompt('Show me the exact Go call to x509.CreateCertificate for both a root and an intermediate CA')
sendPrompt('Why should I parse back and verify the CA certificate after CreateCertificate?')
sendPrompt('How do I PEM-encode a CA certificate and encrypted private key in Go?')
sendPrompt('What is the secure way to store a CA private key on disk, and how does key sealing work in a CVM?')
sendPrompt('How do I add a CA certificate to an x509.CertPool in Go for TLS verification?')
sendPrompt('What are the risks of storing a CA private key as plaintext on disk?')
sendPrompt('Show me how to sign a leaf TLS certificate with a CA in Go')
sendPrompt('How do I sign an intermediate CA certificate with a root CA in Go?')
sendPrompt('How do I generate and sign a CRL with a CA in Go?')
sendPrompt('How do I verify a certificate chain against a CA using x509.CertPool in Go?')
